Base = PLAIN for daily units, WITHIN 1% + SPREAD for weekly and monthly. Bins = the base's R quintiles; the matched difference weights each bin's difference by the stacked group's share in that bin. Valid = censored units excluded at that horizon. Covered = the share of stacked units in a bin that also holds base units; below 100% the matched figure is conditional on those units, at 0% it is unavailable. Cells in parentheses: fewer than 30 valid stacked units at THAT horizon. A shrinking matched gap is attenuation after reweighting to the stacked group's bar sizes, not proof that bar size caused the raw gap.
